messages:
lucy: Heads-up: enabling request-shaper-coalescer v0.3 to canary (eng-runtime). This is a lightweight request-shaping layer before coalescing to reduce duplicate prefix work.
pradeep: TL;DR numbers?
lucy: Quick harness (chat-short, seq=64):
```
Benchmark: chat-short (seq=64)
Baseline   p50=13.0ms  p95=52.1ms  cost=0.129 units
RSC v0.3   p50=9.7ms   p95=49.0ms  cost=0.108 units  (-16.3% cost)
```
tom: Nice. Any impact to request qps or error rates under burst?
lucy: Stress tests show slightly smoothed QPS spikes, error-rate flat. CPU on canary +2.5%, mem unchanged. Effective prefix dedupe +4.2pp.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for request-shaper-coalescer v0.3 (2% eu-central) :rocket:
ops-bot: Ops note — watch the "rsc-coalescer" dashboard and the surge-mitigation panel: https://console.redwood/perf/rsc-v0.3
pradeep: Rollout plan? gates?
lucy: Plan: 2% -> 15% at T+45m -> 50% at T+6h -> 100% at T+24h if clean. Gate: p99 >7% regression OR error-rate increase >0.6% -> immediate rollback.
perf-bot: quick regression scan running — no alerts in first 10m. :white_check_mark:
tom: Any toggles to flip if we need a quick kill?
lucy: CLI toggle: `redwood-admin feature toggle request_shaper_coalescer --env canary --off`. Also config we set on canary:
```yaml
enable_request_shaper_coalescer: true
shaper_window_ms: 5
max_coalesce_delay_ms: 10
dedupe_threshold: 8
```
pradeep: Please tag per-tenant metrics for the first 12h so finance/product can see who benefits.
lucy: Yes — kicking a per-tenant cost-delta job now and will post results to #finance in ~30m.
lucy: will post 45m checkpoint here. Thanks team — nice little win for interactive workloads. :party:
